name: Jobab
overview: Jobab was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Shaharaim according to 1 Chronicles 8:9. Beyond this paternal connection, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notable events concerning his life.
namesAndTitles: The name Jobab means "howl" and is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 8:9. There is no indication that this name was given directly by God, and no additional titles or meanings are attached to it in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jobab as the son of Shaharaim and also lists Hodesh as a son of Shaharaim, suggesting a family lineage within the tribe of Benjamin. No further familial relationships or descendants of Jobab are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Jobab's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, serving as a link in the biblical record of Israelite ancestry. His mention underscores the importance of preserving tribal lineages in the Old Testament narrative, which ultimately contributes to understanding God's providential plan through the tribes of Israel.
